q: How about hearing everything? Even when whispered to?
answer: General knowledge (not from this building's records): Humans can’t literally hear everything, even whispered words. Our ears are most sensitive to mid‑frequency sounds (around 2–4 kHz) and can pick up whispers only in very quiet settings where background noise is below roughly 30 dB. In louder environments the low‑level signal is masked, and even with hearing aids or directional microphones the ability to detect a whisper depends on the device’s gain, frequency response, and the acoustic isolation of the listener. So while technology can extend our hearing range, it can’t make us hear every whispered sound in all conditions.
